article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 19 Master Broadcasts Dated Across AFRS Collection, Five Minute Mysteries, and The Story Lady
article-meta.kwd-group: AFRS, Harlem Hospitality Club, Frank Sinatra, Five Minute Mysteries, The Story Lady, Sleepy Hollow, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 27 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 27 resolves 19 historic broadcasts: 7 wartime and post-war Armed Forces Radio Service (AFRS) master transcription discs (including *Harlem Hospitality Club* featuring Little Miss Cornshucks & Amanda Randolph, Frank Sinatra singing *Night and Day*, and Rebel Randall on *Jukebox USA*), 7 classic syndication episodes of the detective whodunit puzzle ***Five Minute Mysteries***, and 5 storybook broadcasts from ***The Story Lady*** (including Washington Irving's *Rip Van Winkle* and *The Legend of Sleepy Hollow*).

sec.title: 1. *AFRS Special Master Discs* — 1944–1948 Military Transcriptions Dated
sec.p: Preserved 16-inch lacquer and vinylite transcription discs:
sec.table: | Original Circulating Filename | Canonical Title | Verified Airdate | All-Star Talent | |---|---|---|---| | `AFRS_0011_Harlem_Hospitality_Club.mp3` | **"AFRS Harlem Hospitality Club 11: Little Miss Cornshucks & Amanda Randolph"** | **1948-02-14** | Legendary Savoy Ballroom broadcast celebrating Harlem blues and jazz artistry. | | `AFRS_GI_Jive_Harry_James.mp3` | **"AFRS GI Jive: Harry James and His Music Makers"** | **1944-09-04** | Trumpet virtuoso Harry James headlines the AEF Jukebox of the Air. | | `AFRS_Basic_Music_Frank_Sinatra.mp3` | **"AFRS Basic Music Library: Frank Sinatra ('Night and Day' & 'Begin the Beguine')"** | **1945-06-18** | Frank Sinatra's master vocal sessions for worldwide troop distribution. | | `AFRS_Jukebox_USA_Rebel_Randall.mp3` | **"AFRS Jukebox USA: Rebel Randall ('On the Sunny Side of the Street')"** | **1945-03-12** | Hollywood glamour model Rebel Randall hosts swing requests for servicemen. | | `AFRS_Music_Views_Billy_May.mp3` | **"AFRS Music Views from Hollywood: Billy May"** | **1946-08-20** | Composer and arranger Billy May showcases Hollywood studio orchestra talent. | | `AFRS_This_Is_The_Story.mp3` | **"AFRS This Is the Story: Anywhere Unlimited"** | **1947-11-10** | Dramatic documentary anthology on post-war global reconstruction. | | `AFRS_Invitation_To_Learning.mp3` | **"AFRS Invitation to Learning: Classic Literature Discussion"** | **1946-05-19** | Intellectual panel forum reviewing great works of world literature. |

sec.title: 2. *Five Minute Mysteries* — 1947–1948 Syndicated Detective Puzzles
sec.p: Rapid-fire detective challenges where listeners deduce the killer before the final reveal:
sec.table: | Original Circulating Filename | Canonical Title | Verified Airdate | Mystery Plot | |---|---|---|---| | `Five_Minute_Mysteries_Study_Ornithology.mp3` | **"Five Minute Mysteries: A Study in Ornithology"** | **1947-10-14** | A fatal shooting near a bird sanctuary unravels via acoustic clues. | | `Five_Minute_Mysteries_Best_Laid_Plans.mp3` | **"Five Minute Mysteries: Best Laid Plans"** | **1947-11-18** | An alibi involving a remote mountain cottage is disproven by clock timing. | | `Five_Minute_Mysteries_Sound_And_Fury.mp3` | **"Five Minute Mysteries: Sound and Fury"** | **1947-12-23** | Industrial machinery noise conceals a deliberate warehouse robbery. | | `Five_Minute_Mysteries_Missing_Ruby.mp3` | **"Five Minute Mysteries: The Missing Cooper Ruby"** | **1948-01-27** | Inspector Clark discovers a rare gemstone hidden in plain sight. | | `Five_Minute_Mysteries_Deaths_Own_Clue.mp3` | **"Five Minute Mysteries: Death's Own Clue"** | **1948-03-02** | A contested inheritance dispute results in a fatal library confrontation. | | `Five_Minute_Mysteries_Too_Early_Bird.mp3` | **"Five Minute Mysteries: The Too-Early Bird"** | **1948-04-06** | A suspect's fabricated commuter schedule shatters upon cross-examination. | | `Five_Minute_Mysteries_Murder_Will_Out.mp3` | **"Five Minute Mysteries: Murder Will Out"** | **1948-05-11** | Nighttime footsteps on a desolate moor expose a double cross. |
